==Description==
'''Paradoxum Localization Alliance''' is a Roblox group owned by Razuatix. Based on its name, owner and icon, this was most likely another translation group similar to the [[Paradoxum Translators]]. However, since the group is open and uses default Roblox group ranks, it is unlikely this group ended up being used for its intended purpose.

==Ranks==
The '''Paradoxum Translators''' group had 3 ranks, these are:
*Member (1)
*Admin (254)
*Owner (255)
